title: A Blue Hour for the Language
author: Paloma Pemberton
blurb: Odile Voss, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
